meta.title: Blockchain Intelligence for Law Enforcement | Lenix Protocol
meta.description: On-chain tracing, wallet screening, and forensic reports for law enforcement and government teams — scoped engagements with documented methodology and limits.

Hero.subtitle: Trace crypto flows, screen wallets, and produce documented findings for case files — with clear scope on what public ledger analysis can support and what requires separate legal process.

Overview.title: Investigation support built for case work
Overview.description: Lenix helps agencies and task forces follow funds across supported networks, prioritize leads from bulk wallet uploads, and prepare outputs suitable for internal review or exchange escalation — without overstating attribution certainty or recovery outcomes.

follow.title: Follow flows across chains and services
follow.desc: Map movement through bridges, DEX touchpoints, and consolidation wallets where the ledger shows them — with notes on where visibility ends.

data.title: Attribution context for case review
data.desc: Cluster related addresses and flag exposure to known risky categories when your matter authorizes that scope — not a claim of complete wallet ownership.

speed.title: Prioritize viable trails first
speed.desc: Screen wallet or transaction lists before deep analysis so investigators spend time on leads worth pursuing.

evidence.title: Outputs for case files
evidence.desc: Structured timelines and methodology sections suitable for supervisory review, counsel, or exchange escalation requests.

intelligence.label: Threat intelligence
intelligence.title: Datasets tailored to investigation priorities
intelligence.body: Receive structured exports covering wallet clusters, flow summaries, and risk categories relevant to your case set — via file, feed, or API depending on engagement terms.

tracing.label: Cross-network tracing
tracing.title: Trace activity across supported networks
tracing.body: Follow funds across chains and assets where on-chain data allows — including bridge and swap touchpoints — with hop-by-hop documentation for case notes.

triage.label: Triage
triage.title: Screen volume before deep investigation
triage.body: Upload wallet or transaction batches for initial exposure review — sanctions links, scam typologies, and high-risk services — to rank which leads warrant full analysis.

investigation.label: Investigation
investigation.title: Develop the case view
investigation.body: Build linked address and transaction paths in reports that separate verified ledger facts from inference — including likely exchange deposit points when visible on-chain.

training.label: Training
training.title: Operator onboarding for your unit
training.body: Walkthroughs on crypto fundamentals, tracing workflows, and how to read Lenix outputs — scoped to your team's tools access and case types, not generic certification marketing.

Cta.title: Need blockchain support for an investigation?
Cta.description: Describe the unit, case type, and data you already have. We respond with an honest read on what tracing and reporting can cover before scoped engagement.

triage.label: Triage and prioritization
triage.title: Screen leads before deep dives
triage.body: Upload wallet or transaction lists for initial exposure review — sanctions links, known scam categories, and high-risk service touchpoints — so investigators focus effort on viable trails first.

tracing.label: Cross-network tracing
tracing.title: Map flows across chains and services
tracing.body: Follow movement through bridges, swaps, and consolidation points where visible on-chain. Outputs include hop-by-hop notes and timelines your team can attach to case documentation.

investigation.label: Case development
investigation.title: Build an evidence-oriented case view
investigation.body: Link addresses, clusters, and transaction paths in structured reports — separating verified ledger facts from inference, with limits stated for counsel and supervisory review.

escalation.label: Exchange and escalation support
escalation.title: Document touchpoints for next steps
escalation.body: Identify likely custodial deposit paths when the chain shows them — supporting preservation requests, MLAT workflows, or internal escalation. Lenix does not compel exchanges or guarantee KYC disclosure.
